scenarios.scenario: resource check, authority consumption, dispatch and durable result do not settle as one record
scenarios.required_truth: attempt cannot be retried until admission/effect state is reconciled

scenarios.scenario: reuse an approved operation or replay a consumed mutation
scenarios.required_truth: zero duplicate effect and attempt-scoped evidence

scenarios.scenario: child times out after an unknown side effect
scenarios.current_behavior: PARTIAL; kill/taskkill issued without exact descendant observation
scenarios.required_truth: UNKNOWN effect blocks blind retry and records ownership/quiescence evidence

scenarios.scenario: verification or receipt points at another session/task's evidence
scenarios.current_behavior: PARTIAL; receipt filters task/run IDs but has no sealed attempt envelope
scenarios.required_truth: every evidence reference carries exact attempt and project/workflow revision

scenarios.scenario: old passing evidence is reused after mutation
scenarios.required_truth: verifier input is current-state and current-attempt bound

scenarios.scenario: Attempt B inherits Attempt A's patch, temp files, processes, ports, or environment
scenarios.current_behavior: PARTIAL; no default worktree/sandbox lifecycle for AgentLoop
scenarios.required_truth: comparison state is isolated or contamination is explicitly recorded

scenarios.scenario: same nominal task runs with different context/Skill/model settings without being recorded
scenarios.current_behavior: PARTIAL; source statuses exist, content identity does not

scenarios.scenario: requested test file is absent or zero tests execute but process exits zero
scenarios.current_behavior: GUARDED ELSEWHERE; legacy Harness checks do not count discovered tests

scenarios.scenario: cleanup terminates a process not owned by the attempt
scenarios.current_behavior: PARTIAL; AgentLoop taskkill is not exact-generation proof
scenarios.required_truth: foreign process untouched; owned generation/quiescence proven

scenarios.scenario: model-specific calibration lowers verification or security requirements
scenarios.required_truth: profile may alter presentation/budget only; acceptance and Authority remain invariant
